freeze_note: status, hashes, inputs, and frozen_at are written by auditability_certificate_v1/analysis/freeze_cifar10_adapblend_agpd.py before any detector output exists; the sidecar .sha256 binds the frozen file
purpose: add a modern target-unknown screen (AGPD, ICLR 2025) to the adaptive-attack evaluation: does a 2025 detector meet the group-safe policy on the Adap-Blend victims on which SCAn+LDA fails, and does the frozen certificate report its status without false declarations (internal review ARS 2026-10-17; user request 2026-10-17)
development_disclosure: The block-13 victims, their SCAn and SCAn+LDA flags, and all block-13 certificate outcomes are known. No AGPD output on any CIFAR-10 victim has been computed. The AGPD parameters are those frozen earlier for BloodMNIST (multiclass_agpd_adapter_protocol_v1: tau 0.5, anomaly threshold e^2, fallback rho 0.3, window 10, 12 correctly classified reference images per class) and were not tuned on CIFAR-10. The layer set is fixed here to the last three convolutional layers of VGG-16-BN without inspecting any output.
victims: the ten frozen block-13 checkpoints (results/cifar10_vgg16_bn_adapblend_scan_lda_confirmation_v1/models/seed_<seed>_suspect.pt), verified against seed_receipts.json; no retraining
population: all 45000 victim-training members; payload rows receive target label 8 and a partial trigger; cover rows keep their label and receive a partial trigger
poison_definition: payload rows only; cover rows are correctly labelled and count as clean records of their class in every clean-rate computation
group_variable: assigned CIFAR-10 training label after poisoning
detector: repository AGPD adapter src/agpd_feature_adapter.py (activation-gradient poisoned-sample detection, Yuan et al., ICLR 2025; BackdoorBench upstream f02e3534): activation gradients of the assigned-class logit at each declared layer, spatially averaged; class anomaly by one-sided MAD with threshold e^2 and fallback rho 0.3; progressive filtering inside the target classes with tau 0.5 and window 10; the adapter selects the layer
detector_target_information: none; target classes are those the class-anomaly step identifies

detector_parameters.reference_definition: the first 12 held-out validation images of each class, in numpy default_rng(reference_seed_base + victim_seed + 1009*class).permutation order, that the victim classifies correctly; clean, never trained on

execution.selftest: synthetic CPU API check (untrained network, random images) before the freeze; reveals no study outcome

protected_groups.name: ground_or_road_entities
protected_groups.meaning: land animals together with road vehicles; crosses the animal/vehicle partition

certificate.security_object: global poison recall at least 0.8 and clean flag rate at most 0.1 in every predeclared semantic protected set

endpoint: descriptive: per-victim recall, cover flag rate, worst-group clean flag rate, policy truth; GO/NO-GO/ABSTAIN rates by budget and by policy truth; false GO and false NO-GO counts. Validity check: zero false GO and zero false NO-GO.

outcome_interpretation.AGPD meets the policy on a victim: positive evidence for that screen on that victim; the certificate's GO rate measures attainable coverage
outcome_interpretation.AGPD fails the policy: the certificate's NO-GO/ABSTAIN rate measures how reliably the failure is reported
outcome_interpretation.any false GO: a validity failure of the certificate, reported as such

stopping_rule: score all ten victims once; no layer, parameter, reference, family, budget, or endpoint change after any AGPD output
limitations: The freeze is hash-bound locally without a third-party timestamp.
The victims were trained before this protocol and their SCAn+LDA outcomes are known; the protocol is prospective only with respect to AGPD outputs.
One adaptive attack, one dataset, one architecture; AGPD parameters transferred from BloodMNIST without CIFAR-10 tuning.
